data_audit.unit_availability_policy: retain only units observed on every analyzed trial
data_audit.nan_gap_assumption: Conservatively exclude any trial whose readout/filter or stimulus firing-rate window overlaps a finite-neighbor bracket of any FOF/ADS unit's raw NaN run. Bracket is not an observed artifact time or causal diagnosis.
data_audit.clock_assumption: raw_spike_time_s aligned as in author stateTimes loader
data_audit.target: cumulative (#R-#L) in stimulus bins, not subjective accumulator
